usage: • Used for the gemstone ruby, often in jewellery, watches, and luxury items.
• Common in fixed phrases with jewellery or colour descriptions, especially when talking about a deep red stone.
• Countable in Chinese? Usually treated as a material/thing name, so no article marking like in English.
• Learners should remember the pronunciation is hung4 bou2 sek6; the word is formal but very common in shopping and gem-related contexts.

examples.sentence: 呢隻戒指鑲咗一粒好靚嘅紅寶石。
examples.jyutping: ni1 zek3 gaai3 zi2 soeng1 zo2 jat1 sap1 ho2 leng3 ge3 hung4 bou2 sek6.
examples.meaning: This ring is set with a very beautiful ruby.
